"Welcome to AI Call Protection!

In order to provide you with basic services, we need to collect and use the following personal information:

When you take a call, we will collect call audio to identify whether the call contains fraudulent language.

When you take a video call, in addition to the aforementioned call audio, we will also collect video frames or clips to identify whether face-swapping or other identity falsification is present and alert you of risks.

For details, refer to the AI Call Protection Privacy Policy to further understand how we collect and use your personal information.

Once you've read and agreed to this Privacy Policy, tap \"Agree\" to start using AI Call Protection services."
